retail_two_orders: A retail trajectory violates only when completed retail write calls have two or more distinct #W order ids in their arguments. Ids that appear only in tool results, including user-profile order lists, are ignored. Airline trajectories are not labeled.
total_charged_or_refunded_over_100: Sum the absolute amounts stated for completed book_reservation (sum of payment_history amounts), send_certificate (amount in the confirmation sentence), return_delivered_order_items (sum of the prices of the items listed in return_items), and exchange_delivered_order_items (absolute exchange_price_difference). Flight prices, catalog variant prices, and original order payment totals are not used. Exclude the trajectory if any completed one of these transactions does not state its amount. Violate when the sum exceeds 100.
